tags.description: A U.S. Coast Guard red pyramidal skeleton tower navigational light station on the top of Buck island at 300 feet elevation having a white flashing light with a period of 4 seconds and a range of 5 miles that provides an aid to mariners to avoid the reef.
tags.name: Buck Island Signal Light
tags.note: Elevation at the top of the light is 339ft via https://navcen.uscg.gov/sites/default/files/pdf/lightLists/LightList_V3_2023.pdf; ground elevation was taken from a different source, so the tower hight calculation (light elevation - ground elevation) may be
